description: Source code for a library managing signal handling, file output, threading, and cleanup routines, likely part of a larger system for managing output and signals in an embedded or system-level application.

classes.name: crtl_event_type_t
classes.description: Enumeration of event types for signaling thread termination and signals.

classes.name: crtl_event_t
classes.description: Structure representing an event with a type and semaphore.

classes.name: crtl_thread_params_t
classes.description: Parameters passed to the main thread, including file descriptors and semaphore.

classes.name: crtl_signals_t
classes.description: Structure for managing signal number and handler installation status.

classes.name: crtl_global_t
classes.description: Global state structure holding configuration, file descriptors, threading info, and buffers.

methods.name: crtl_signals_register
methods.description: Registers signal handlers for various fatal signals.

methods.name: crtl_signal_handler
methods.description: Handles signals by flushing output, cleaning up, and re-raising the signal.

methods.name: crtl_abort
methods.description: Attempts to flush output and process remaining input safely during a crash or fatal signal.
